name: Astec Valves & Fittings Pvt. Ltd.
semiconductor_relevance: None -- the company's primary focus is on valves and fittings for industrial applications, not semiconductors
india_angle: Astec Valves & Fittings Private Limited has its head office and manufacturing facilities in Maharashtra, India.
summary: Astec Valves & Fittings Pvt. Ltd. specializes in the production of valves and fittings for various industrial sectors including oil & gas, petrochemical, and power plants. Their expertise lies in providing solutions for instrumentation and piping engineers to optimize process measurement and maintenance.
